id: 33_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder - Calibrate the Welding Gun Focus
title: 激光焊机：校准焊枪焦点
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/33_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder - Calibrate the Welding Gun Focus.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/33_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder - Calibrate the Welding Gun Focus/src.py

points.K1: 在系统设置里查参考值
points.K3: 开卡扣，推拉刻度管到参考值

shots.scene: 欣欣举着焊枪，指着枪管上的一圈刻度
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a handheld laser welding gun and points at the graduated scale on its barrel.
shots.narration: 这一课讲焊枪焦距怎样校准。
overlay: 激光焊接机焊枪焦距的校准

shots.scene: 三个步骤图标：设置屏幕、电源开关、刻度管
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a settings screen, a power switch turned off and a graduated tube. No people.

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着焊枪，看着枪管上的刻度
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds the welding gun and looks at the graduated scale on its barrel.
shots.narration: 阿杰注意到焊枪上有一圈刻度。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，看看屏幕又看看焊枪
shots.prompt_en: He scratches his head, looking from the touch screen to the gun and back.

shots.scene: 老李走过来，指了指触摸屏
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks over and points at the touch screen.
shots.narration: 老李说：要和屏幕上的参考值对上。

shots.scene: 触摸屏和焊枪刻度管之间画着一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A question mark floats between the touch screen of the main unit and the graduated tube of the welding gun. No people.
shots.narration: 参考值在哪儿看？怎么调？

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.

shots.section_title: 在系统设置里查参考值
shots.scene: 主机触摸屏亮着，显示空白主界面
shots.prompt_en: The touch screen of the main unit is on, showing a blank home page. No people.
shots.narration: 第一步，在主机屏幕上查参考值。
overlay: 在系统设置里查参考值

shots.section_title: 在系统设置里查参考值
shots.scene: 老李在触摸屏上点开系统设置
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer taps the system settings item on the touch screen of the main unit.

shots.section_title: 在系统设置里查参考值
shots.scene: 机器信息列表，最后一行被放大圈出
shots.prompt_en: A blank machine information list on the screen, with its last line magnified by a circle. No people.

shots.section_title: 在系统设置里查参考值
shots.scene: 放大的最后一行，只有一个空白数值框
shots.prompt_en: The magnified last line shows a single blank value box. No people.

shots.scene: 老李走到主机背面
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks around to the back of the main unit.

shots.scene: 老李按下背面电源开关到关闭
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses the rocker switch on the back of the main unit to off.

shots.section_title: 开卡扣，推拉刻度管到参考值
shots.scene: 老李手持焊枪，刻度管特写
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds the welding gun in his hand; close view of its graduated tube.
shots.narration: 第三步，看焊枪上的刻度管。
overlay: 开卡扣，推拉刻度管到参考值

shots.section_title: 开卡扣，推拉刻度管到参考值
shots.scene: 焊枪刻度管与参考值对照，数字一致打勾
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the gun's graduated tube beside a note card; matching marks with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 刻度和参考值一致，就不用调。

shots.section_title: 开卡扣，推拉刻度管到参考值
shots.scene: 老李打开刻度管上的卡扣
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens the clamp on the graduated tube of the welding gun.

shots.section_title: 开卡扣，推拉刻度管到参考值
shots.scene: 刻度管上的卡扣打开的特写
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the opened clamp on the graduated tube of the welding gun. No people.
shots.narration: 卡扣打开，刻度管就能动了。

shots.section_title: 开卡扣，推拉刻度管到参考值
shots.scene: 老李推拉刻度管
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer slides the graduated tube in and out.

shots.section_title: 开卡扣，推拉刻度管到参考值
shots.scene: 刻度管上的刻度对准参考标记
shots.prompt_en: Close view: the mark on the graduated tube lines up with the reference mark. No people.
shots.narration: 直到刻度和参考值一致。

shots.scene: 欣欣身后浮现几个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands with icons behind: a settings screen, a power switch off and a graduated tube.
shots.narration: 系统设置里，查焦距刻度参考值。

shots.scene: 欣欣伸出手指数着
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot counts on its fingers.

shots.scene: 欣欣指着焊枪的刻度管
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the graduated tube on the welding gun.
shots.narration: 一致不用调，不一致就推拉对准。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着焊枪，刻度与参考值一致，他点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds the welding gun with its scale matching the reference and nods.

shots.scene: 欣欣、老李和阿杰挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the facility engineer and the young male student wave goodbye at the camera.
